subject: The shortcut 90% of users miss
preview_text: You've been using Bass Booster wrong. One tap changes everything.
body_paragraphs: You're probably boosting the bass slider. That's fine, but it's not the real move. The power users—the ones who make Hip-Hop hit like a subwoofer—never touch the slider until after they've opened the EQ panel. They know the shortcut that turns a flat track into a chest-rattling drop.

Here's the hidden workflow: tap the 10-band EQ, bump the 60Hz and 120Hz bands up by 6dB each, then leave the bass virtualizer off. The virtualizer is a crutch. Real bass comes from shaping the frequencies yourself. This is the difference between hearing the beat and feeling it in your ribs.

Open the app right now. Tap the EQ, set those two bands, then play your favorite track. You'll hear the low-end punch through your earbuds like never before. It's a two-second tweak that makes your phone sound like a proper system. No premium needed—this works on the free profile.
Try it once. You'll never go back to the slider alone. P.S. When you're ready, Premium unlocks the full 10-band EQ plus unlimited boost. But this one shortcut is yours for free. Feel the drop.
